## Why
Members change plans; the spot should go to someone else.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A member cancels their own booking; the spot is freed.
2. A member cannot cancel another member's booking.
3. Cancelling twice changes nothing.
4. A cancelled class no longer appears in the member's bookings.

## Notes / decisions
- The spec says bookings are paid; it does not say what happens to the payment on cancellation.
